title: Private Network Attestation + Compact Economics Strip (onboarding & incident actions)
creator: Ava Martínez
description: Goal: Design a compact, actionable UI element that surfaces private network attestation state (connectivity checks, routing validation, policy compliance) and a single-line economics summary (recent egress/spike cost delta, suggested throttle) for Private/VPC tenants. This ticket covers discovery, low-fidelity prototypes, and a high-fidelity review-ready flow for the cluster detail header and the operations quick-strip used in incident and onboarding scenarios. The element must be concise (one row on compact consoles), keyboard accessible, and include progressive disclosure to a richer ops pane.
scope:
- Attestation badge states (passing, degraded, failing) with confidence tooltip
- Inline quick-actions: re-run attestation, open connectivity replay, open upgrade-safe rollback
- Compact economics strip showing 24h egress delta, projected burst cost, and an auto-suggested throttle action
- Expand to a side-panel with timeline and remit links to canary rollback and cost forecast simulator
constraints:
- Must align with existing console compact density styles
- Limited horizontal space in tenant header, prioritize iconography + one-line summary
- Data availability: assume attestation check endpoint and 24h cost delta metrics are provided by backend team (ENG-79210)
acceptance_criteria: Low-fi flow and three hi-fi prototypes (header, ops quick-strip, expanded side-panel) in Figma
Design tokens and responsive behavior documented for compact and regular density
Accessibility checks: color contrast and keyboard interactability validated
Engineering handoff doc with a prioritized interaction list and API contract examples
comments: 2025-11-05 - Ava M: Kickoff complete. Spent 30m with Runtime/Infra to validate attestation metrics. Backend can provide pass/degraded/fail plus last-run timestamp and trace-id. Cost metrics available as 24h delta and 7d baseline.
2025-11-07 - Sophie C: Added initial sketches for header badge + hover card. Proposal: small badge with chevron to expand into ops quick-strip. Need PM signoff on suggested throttle default behavior.
2025-11-09 - Raj P (Eng): Confirmed endpoint shape and latency SLAs. Note: attestation runs may be async; include stale-state indicator and manual re-run action.
2025-11-10 - PM (Mina G): PM review: prioritize onboarding flow first, then incident-mode. For onboarding we should show step-to-step attestation checks and a 'verify & continue' CTA.

2025-11-11 - Design review: feedback to reduce copy, change 'projected burst cost' to 'estimated spike', and add a small info icon linking to cost explainer. Also requested keyboard focus state for inline actions.
2025-11-12 - Sophie C: Uploaded hi-fi variants and prepared engineering token export. Leaving open questions about telemetry and error copy (see decision_log).
decision_log: 2025-11-08 - Decision: Use three attestation states (ok/degraded/fail) instead of five to keep UI compact.
2025-11-10 - Decision: Economics strip will show only 24h egress delta + suggested throttle. Full cost breakdown lives in the expanded panel.
2025-11-11 - Decision: Inline throttle action triggers a confirm modal with 'simulate impact' option that calls the cost-forecast simulator (backend tie-in: ENG-79823).
2025-11-12 - Open: final copy for failure state needs legal review if it mentions SLA exposure (action: PM to confirm).
handoff_notes:
- Exports: Figma frames named 'Header-Compact', 'Ops-QuickStrip', 'Expanded-Attestation-Panel'.
- Tokens: spacing and color tokens attached to figma file.
- Interaction list: hover->tooltip, click->expand, keyboard Enter to activate, Shift+Enter to run attestation.
- Engineering needs to implement a retry/backoff indicator for re-run action.
